Open de exacte URL en controleer wat de: Open the exact URL and check what the server returns. An existing page should normally give a successful response. An error page can look neat and yet return an incorrect status. Conversely, a true 404 for a permanently deleted page is not automatically an issue that needs to be resolved.
Maak onderscheid tussen een verhuisde pa: Distinguish between a moved page and content that no longer exists. In the event of a move, permanent redirection to the substantive successor is appropriate. Sending all old URLs to the homepage usually does not help a visitor looking for a specific service.
Controleer de URL in Search Console en b: Check the URL in Search Console and also view the live test. A noindex instruction asks search engines not to include the page. A block in robots.txt limits crawling; that's not a reliable way to remove a known URL from search results.
Controleer vervolgens de voorkeurs-URL,: Then check the preferred URL, also known as canonical. This should match the intended version of the content. Don't put all the canonicals on the homepage. Use the same preferred version in internal links and the sitemap. A technically valid page is not automatically indexed by Google.
3. Begrijpt de bezoeker de pagina op mob: 3. Does the visitor understand the page on mobile?
Test koppen, tekst, links en formulieren: Test headlines, text, links and forms on a small screen. Can someone understand the service and reach out without zooming in? Does a fixed menu cover the heading that a page link jumps to? Does an error message work understandably when a mandatory field remains empty?
Een belangrijk deel van deze controle is: An important part of this control is manual. For example, a score does not show whether the form actually reaches your company after completion. Check that entire route with test data and confirm receipt before notifying visitors of a successful shipment.
4. Onderzoek snelheid met een concrete h: 4. Investigate speed with a concrete hypothesis
Begin met de onderdelen die tijdens het: Start with the items that should load during the first screen. Is the main image much larger than the display requires? Are heavy scripts loaded that are not needed there? Does the page reserve space for images so that text doesn't shift unexpectedly?
